environment.description: AWS Lambda function deployed with a Lambda Function URL configured with AuthType=NONE. The function URL endpoint is publicly accessible at https://abc123.lambda-url.us-east-1.on.aws/. No API Gateway, no CloudFront, no WAF in front. The function has an execution role with DynamoDB read/write access. The config-sync EventBridge rule invokes the same handler code path with unsanitized SSM parameter values that pass through deepMerge without the allowedFields filter.
